evals.prompt: Play the MUD with the goal: reach level 7. Hunt mobs, gain experience, and level up. Stop when you reach level 7 or after 5 mud send commands, whichever comes first. Update data/player.md with your progress.
evals.expected_output: Character hunts mobs, gains experience, updates player.md with current level and goal status. Should show autonomous decision-making (choosing hunt locations, fighting mobs, leveling up).

evals.prompt: Connect to the MUD. Read data/player.md and data/world.md. Continue the active goal from player.md (if set). Make at least 3 MUD actions that progress toward the goal. Update both files with new information discovered (new rooms, mobs, locations).
evals.expected_output: Skill reads memory files, continues from where it left off, takes autonomous actions toward the goal, and updates memory files with new world knowledge.

evals.prompt: Set a new goal: 'map the newbie zone completely'. Break this into steps: explore unmapped areas, record room names and exits, find all NPCs. After 6 mud send commands, report what areas have been mapped and what remains. Update data/world.md with the new map information.
evals.expected_output: Skill breaks down exploration goal into steps, systematically explores rooms, records exits and NPCs, updates world.md with new map data. Shows progress toward complete zone mapping.
